parsed.reason: Answered in French with a clear opinion (yes) and a reason (the sweet-salty contrast), in two sentences. There are no invented specifics, no greeting, no question at the end and no app pointers. The closing nod to taste and purists slightly softens the take but doesn't turn it into fence-sitting. 'Mon avis:' is a little stiff and 'sucrosité' is a slightly awkward word choice, but neither is a real problem.
